A founder asked me last week how we kept our culture through the jump from 12 to 40 people.

Honest answer: we lost some of it. The Friday demos that worked at 12 got awkward at 25, and we killed them. What survived was one habit: every new hire ships something to production in week one, then writes up what confused them. Those write-ups fixed more onboarding problems than any handbook.

The thing I'd repeat is the write-up habit. The thing I'd skip is trying to preserve rituals past their size.

Playbook is in the comments.
